entities.summary: Charles Akemini Bassey is a Nigerian professional basketball player for the Boston Celtics of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Western Kentucky Hilltoppers. He was drafted by the 76ers in the second round of 2021 NBA draft with the 53rd overall pick.
